## Key Functions in `bspam` Package

| Function | Purpose |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `fit.model()` | Estimate task parameters by MCEM or Bayesian estimation |
| `scoring()` | Estimate latent factor scores and model-based WCPM scores |
| `summary()` | Produce summary output for calibration and scoring results |
| `get.cases()` | Generate a list of person-by-occasion case identifiers |
| `plot.task()` | Visualize task parameter estimates |
| `plot.person()` | Visualize person-level score estimates |
| `plot.information()` | Visualize the information function for task parameters |
